text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I really did want to run in the 
fan meeting relay after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no! Sulking won't help 
anything. If I wasn't chosen, it just 
means I wasn't good enough yet!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If anything, we should be the ones 
cheering the loudest! Let's prep some cold 
sports drinks too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll do lots more training too...! And 
then, someday, I will too!
